title: Settings
subtitle: Language, privacy threshold, demo faults, session and demo reset.
languageHint: Saved on this device and kept after reload or offline. Numbers are the same in every language.

threshold.label: Small-number suppression threshold (demo)
threshold.description: Counts above zero and below this number are hidden on every dashboard, drill-down and CSV export.
threshold.readOnly: Set by programme lead (demo policy, not approved for production).
threshold.hint: Whole number from {{min}} to {{max}}. {{min}} is the governance minimum.
threshold.justificationHint: {{min}}–{{max}} characters, recorded in the audit log ({{count}} so far).
threshold.auditNote: The change is audited with the old and new value and your justification.
threshold.preview: At k = {{k}}, {{n}} cells in the current Overview would be suppressed.

validation.range: Enter a whole number from 3 to 20
validation.unchanged: This is already the threshold in force.
validation.justification: Give a justification of {{min}} to {{max}} characters.

conflict.title: The threshold was changed by someone else
conflict.description: Your change was not saved. Keep the latest value, or apply yours on top of it.

threshold.notSaved: Not saved — retry. Your input is kept.
threshold.forbidden: Only the programme lead can change the threshold. The attempt was recorded.
threshold.failed: The threshold could not be saved.

faults.title: Demo fault simulation
faults.description: Simulate network problems to see how each page behaves. No real service is involved.
faults.serverErrorHint: Calls fail before they run (nothing is saved).
faults.timeoutHint: The write is saved but the answer is lost; retrying must not duplicate it.
faults.offlineHint: Every call fails as if the connection were lost.
faults.conflict: Conflict on the next threshold change
faults.conflictHint: The next save behaves as if someone else changed the threshold first.
faults.footnote: Demo tooling only: fault switches are not business decisions and are not part of the governance audit trail. Reset demo clears them.

session.title: Demo session
session.expireHint: Expire the session to test what happens when a sign-in runs out: your next action asks you to sign in again and returns you to the same view.
session.expiredToast: Session expired. Your next action will ask you to sign in again.
session.expiredStatus: This session has expired. Navigate or act to sign in again.

reset.title: Reset demo
reset.description: Restores the exact baseline: data, audit log, settings, demo clock. Ends this session.
reset.dialogDescription: Every change made in this demo is removed and you return to the sign-in.
reset.confirm: Type RESET to restore the demo data
reset.confirmHint: Type the word {{token}} exactly, in capital letters.
